highlights_led_by_exploit_ready_vulns: CISA sets urgent deadline to fix Cisco flaw exploited in attacks and Mandiant reveals how Cisco SD-WAN zero-day attacks gained root access. Treat newly published PoCs and early exploitation signals as immediate patch/mitigation triggers for internet-facing and fleet-wide infrastructure.
endpoint_posture_under_pressure: Week in review: Fortibleed campaign’s impact on orgs, Cisco Unified CM flaw exploited. Tighten EDR coverage, block known IoCs where available, and validate software supply-chain integrity in build and CI/CD.
